analysis.evidence: Lot chose the whole Jordan plain for himself. אֵת marks כָּל כִּכַּר הַיַּרְדֵּן as the object of his choice, and לוֹ means “for himself.”
analysis.morphology: The prefixed conjunction וַ introduces a Qal wayyiqtol, third person masculine singular, with Lot as its subject.
